description:
A grant proposal has been submitted, and the reference materials need to be archived. Your task is to:
1. Open the collection 'NeurIPS 2023 Draft' in the left sidebar.
2. Select all papers in this collection and add the tag 'submitted-2023' to them.
3. Export this specific collection (not the whole library) to an RIS file named 'neurips_archive.ris' in the '/home/ga/Documents/' folder.
4. Delete the 'NeurIPS 2023 Draft' collection from the sidebar. IMPORTANT: Do NOT delete the items from your library; they must remain in 'My Library' for future use.

target_papers: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
